items.notes:
This is the “parent” object of a recurrent event.
If today is a match, it will create a “child” event in “All” section.
A recurrent event is evaluate when the app start. When a new recurrent event is created and today is a match, restart the app to have it shown in “All”.
The “child” object is the same as a normal task. It inherit everything from the “parent” but can be edited. Changed will not be saved in the “parent” object.
items.title: RecurrentDailyObject

items.notes:
A event lasting for multiple days. Show up in the different sections based on different criteria:
	Today: any time in range
	Upcoming: depend on start date
	Overdue: depend on end date

Note it is different to a recurrent event happening everyday
items.title: Multi-day

items.notes:
Cmd+N: create new task

Data is saved at ~/Library/Application Support/TodoList/todos.json

In “All”, tasks can be dragged to sort or to be a subtask of another main. Only one layer of sub is supported.

Searching currently search in title and notes.

Task in “Completed” will be automatically deleted in 3 days. Task in “Trash” will be automatically cleared in 3 days.
